channel.description: Recent content in Dignity on Pivtorak.Studio

item.title: 006 Independent Researcher Manifesto: The Right to Human Outcomes
item.description: Systems, models, and institutions are instruments of navigation. Their value is determined by whether they help people live, love, create, return home, and build the future.

item.title: 028 The Right Not to Listen to an Anthem of Aggression
item.description: Inspired by the actions of Ukrainian rhythmic gymnasts during the 2026 European Championships, this essay explores the human right to preserve an inner space free from symbols associated with violence, loss, and aggression.

item.title: 030 A Song Stronger Than Noise
item.description: Inspired by the everyday experience of Ukrainians who use music, voices, and familiar sounds to preserve their inner balance during air raids, this essay explores how peace can survive even when the world grows unbearably loud.

item.title: 09-03 Persia 2.0: Global Dimension. The Human Subject (Citizen of the World with a Persian Heart)
item.description: Persia establishes Human-Centricity as a civilizational doctrine. The state becomes infrastructure that serves human potential, while every individual regains agency as a citizen of the world with a Persian heart.

item.title: ✯ Extra Credit Problem (The Asterisk Problem)
item.description: A multidisciplinary research framework examining countries and regions where freedom, human dignity, child protection, and individual agency face systemic challenges. Each case study maps the path from tragedy and diagnosis to recovery, subjectivity, and civilizational renewal.
